description: This file defines the SparkException class and various specialized exception classes used within Apache Spark, including methods for constructing and handling exceptions with error classes, message parameters, and context information.

classes.name: SparkException
classes.description: Base exception class for Spark, supporting error classes, message parameters, context, and SQL state.

classes.name: SparkDriverExecutionException
classes.description: Indicates failure in executing user code within the Spark driver process.

classes.name: SparkUserAppException
classes.description: Represents an exception when a user application run as a child process exits with a specific exit code.

classes.name: ExecutorDeadException
classes.description: Indicates that a specified executor is dead.

classes.name: SparkUpgradeException
classes.description: Signals that Spark returned different results after an upgrade.

classes.name: SparkArithmeticException
classes.description: Arithmetic error with an associated error class.

classes.name: SparkUnsupportedOperationException
classes.description: Indicates an unsupported operation with an error class.

classes.name: SparkClassNotFoundException
classes.description: Thrown when a class cannot be found, with an error class.

classes.name: SparkConcurrentModificationException
classes.description: Indicates a concurrent modification error with an error class.

classes.name: SparkDateTimeException
classes.description: Datetime-related error with an error class.

classes.name: SparkFileNotFoundException
classes.description: Thrown when a file is not found, with an error class.

classes.name: SparkNumberFormatException
classes.description: Number format error with an error class.

classes.name: SparkIllegalArgumentException
classes.description: Illegal argument error with an error class.

classes.name: SparkIllegalStateException
classes.description: Illegal state error with an error class.

classes.name: SparkRuntimeException
classes.description: General runtime exception with an error class.

classes.name: SparkPythonException
classes.description: Exception for Python-related errors with an error class.

classes.name: SparkNoSuchElementException
classes.description: Indicates a missing element error with an error class.

classes.name: SparkSecurityException
classes.description: Security-related error with an error class.

classes.name: SparkArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
classes.description: Array index out of bounds error with an error class.

classes.name: SparkSQLException
classes.description: SQL exception with an error class.

classes.name: SparkSQLFeatureNotSupportedException
classes.description: Indicates a feature not supported in SQL, with an error class.

methods.name: SparkException
methods.description: Constructor for creating SparkException instances with various parameters.

methods.name: internalError
methods.description: Creates an internal error SparkException with optional category and message.

methods.name: require
methods.description: Checks a requirement and throws SparkIllegalArgumentException if false.

methods.name: constructMessageParams
methods.description: Converts Java Map to Scala Map for message parameters.

methods.name: mustOverrideOneMethodError
methods.description: Generates an error indicating a method must be overridden.
